## File: facebookresearch_pyrobot/src/pyrobot/allegro_hand/gripper.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to initialize an AllegroHand gripper with grasp or torque controller configs', 'create a function that sets desired joint angles for all AllegroHand gripper joints in radians', 'test the AllegroHand get_joint_angles method to return current joint positions as a numpy array', 'refactor the AllegroHand set_joint_torques method to publish target torques via the torque controller', 'review the AllegroHand open and close methods that use home and envelop primitives']
```

